messages:
rebecca: Quick sync 1: VendorBridge marketplace tile goes live 06:00 PT tomorrow. We need an explicit partner escalation lane for launch-watch (first 48h). Minimal, machine-readable, and easy to follow.

omar: Agreed. My suggested flow: shared channel -> Redwood monitor -> partner eng. Keep timings strict: 0-12m local triage, 12-30m Redwood mitigation, 30-90m partner deep-dive or warroom.

Priya: Can we make the shared channel name deterministic so infra can wire webhooks? propose: #vb-launch-ops.<env> (e.g. #vb-launch-ops.prod). Pin a single-runbook.md + contact card.

rebecca: Love that. Also want a warm-watch schedule: 2 people, 45m shifts for first 6h, then 2hr checks until 48h. Reduces alarm fatigue and keeps eyes on the dashboard.

dan: ops-bot can scaffold the channel and pins if we pass JSON payload. Example: 
```
/ops-bot scaffold-channel {
  "name": "vb-launch-ops.prod",
  "pins": ["runbook.md","contacts.md"],
  "invites": ["@rebecca","@omar","@Priya","@dan"]
}
/ops-bot route-alerts alert.group=vendorbridge.launch -> #vb-launch-ops.prod
```

omar: Also add a fallback routing rule: if us-west PD is saturated, route to eu-oncall with note "region-fallback". Important for market launches.

Priya: I'll draft the pinned one-pager with: escalation order, warm-watch rota, quick rollback toggle, comms snippet for partner CSMs, and a postmortem trigger (auto-assign if Sev2+).

rebecca: We should also add a small Slack workflow to capture incident metadata at first message: region, customer-impact (Y/N), severity, mitigation in place. That gets pinned automatically.

ops-bot: action: /create-workflow vb-incident-capture -> fields [region,severity,customer_impact,owner] -> post to #vb-launch-ops.prod

dan: Suggest timeline in runbook: 0-12m partner/SI triage in channel -> 12-30m Redwood oncall engaged -> 30-60m partner eng -> 60m+ open warroom + exec notif if P1.

omar: For automations: webhooks should include customer_impact boolean. If true and severity>=high then page PD immediately and create bridge.

Priya: Good. I'll add sample PD policy rules in the runbook and a sample bridge template: 
```
/bridge create vb-launch-live --title "VendorBridge Launch  War Room" --ops @rebecca,@omar,@Priya --duration 3h
```

rebecca: One last ask 1: Make sure the announcement post that goes to marketing includes the ops link and the short sentence: "Support path: #vb-launch-ops.prod (warm-watch 48h) -> partner escalation as documented." Keeps expectations clear.

ops-bot: note: dry-run available: /ops-bot dry-run vb-launch-ops.prod to validate webhooks, PD policy, and bridge template

dan: I'll run the dry-run later today and share results. Thanks team, will expect the pinned runbook by EOD from Priya.

Priya: Will do 1 — dropping draft into channel when ready.

rebecca: Great. After dry-run and PD policy created, I'll add a 1-paragraph ops note to the launch announcement and link the channel. :thumbsup:
